recordings.title: Gain
recordings.description: Gain moves from 0 dB to −60 dB about three seconds in, while a 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Gain. More negative values make it quieter.

recordings.title: Volume
recordings.description: Volume moves from 100% to 0% about three seconds in, while a 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Volume. 0% silences this output.

recordings.title: Bass
recordings.description: Bass moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Cuts low frequencies.

recordings.title: Treble
recordings.description: Treble moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Reduces brightness.

recordings.title: Bass frequency
recordings.description: Bass frequency moves from 500 Hz to 160 Hz about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Keeps the adjustment lower in the spectrum.

recordings.title: Treble frequency
recordings.description: Treble frequency moves from 1,500 Hz to 5,000 Hz about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Keeps the adjustment in higher frequencies.

recordings.title: 31.5 Hz
recordings.description: 31.5 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost only if your source has clean sub-bass and your speakers can reproduce it.

recordings.title: 63 Hz
recordings.description: 63 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a small amount when a clean source sounds too thin at the bottom.

recordings.title: 125 Hz
recordings.description: 125 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a little if a close-miked voice or instrument feels too lean.

recordings.title: 250 Hz
recordings.description: 250 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost gently when a source lacks body and sounds small.

recordings.title: 500 Hz
recordings.description: 500 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost modestly if it has lost body after other cuts.

recordings.title: 1 kHz
recordings.description: 1 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a little if the midrange feels distant after level matching.

recordings.title: 2 kHz
recordings.description: 2 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost gently when a voice is clear but its articulation is buried.

recordings.title: 4 kHz
recordings.description: 4 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a little when speech lacks presence against background sound.

recordings.title: 8 kHz
recordings.description: 8 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost subtly if a clean source sounds dull and needs a little sparkle.

recordings.title: 16 kHz
recordings.description: 16 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. A tiny boost can add air to a clean, full-band source.

recordings.title: Band enabled · band 1
recordings.description: Band enabled · band 1 is turned off about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Off removes its processing contribution.

recordings.title: Filter type · band 1
recordings.description: Filter type · band 1 switches from Peaking to Low pass about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Shape of the selected filter.

recordings.title: Frequency · band 1
recordings.description: Frequency · band 1 moves from 1,000 Hz to 20 Hz about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Moves it toward lower-pitched content.

recordings.title: Q · band 1
recordings.description: Q · band 1 moves from 1 to 8 about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Narrows bell/notch/band-pass filters; may increase resonance in pass filters.

recordings.title: Gain · band 1
recordings.description: Gain · band 1 moves from 9 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Cuts their affected region.

recordings.title: Threshold
recordings.description: Threshold moves from −18 dBFS to −60 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Lower values compress more of the signal.

recordings.title: Ratio
recordings.description: Ratio moves from 3:1 to 8:1 about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Applies stronger level reduction.

recordings.title: Attack
recordings.description: Attack moves from 10 ms to 100 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes engagement slower.

recordings.title: Release
recordings.description: Release moves from 150 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes recovery slower.

recordings.title: Knee
recordings.description: Knee moves from 6 dB to 18 dB about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes compression begin more gradually around the boundary.

recordings.title: Makeup gain
recordings.description: Makeup gain moves from 0 dB to 24 dB about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes the compressed output louder.

recordings.title: Threshold
recordings.description: Threshold moves from −45 dBFS to −80 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Gate / Expander. Opens for quieter sound and potentially room noise.

recordings.title: Range
recordings.description: Range moves from 60 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Preserves more background; 0 dB disables attenuation.

recordings.title: Attack
recordings.description: Attack moves from 5 ms to 100 ms about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Makes engagement slower.

recordings.title: Hysteresis
recordings.description: Hysteresis moves from 3 dB to 9 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Keeps it open through larger level dips.

recordings.title: Ratio
recordings.description: Ratio moves from 4:1 to 1:1 about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Approaches unchanged dynamics at 1:1.

recordings.title: Hold
recordings.description: Hold moves from 50 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Bridges longer gaps.

recordings.title: Release
recordings.description: Release moves from 150 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Makes recovery slower.

recordings.title: Ceiling
recordings.description: Ceiling moves from −1 dBFS to −12 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Limiter. Leaves more headroom.

recordings.title: Look-ahead
recordings.description: Look-ahead moves from 5 ms to 10 ms about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Limiter. Adds more look-ahead and delay.

recordings.title: Release
recordings.description: Release moves from 100 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Limiter. Makes recovery slower.

recordings.title: Delay
recordings.description: Delay moves from 0 ms to 1,000 ms about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Sync (delay). Moves sound later.

recordings.title: Semitones
recordings.description: Semitones moves from 0 to −12 about three seconds in, while a tone that steps up from 220 Hz to 1,760 Hz plays through the Pitch. Lowers pitch.

recordings.title: Fine tune
recordings.description: Fine tune moves from 0 cents to 70 cents about three seconds in, while a tone that steps up from 220 Hz to 1,760 Hz plays through the Pitch. Raises pitch slightly.

recordings.title: Mains frequency
recordings.description: Mains frequency moves from 60 Hz to 45 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice over 50 Hz mains hum plays through the Dehum. Moves the series lower.

recordings.title: Amount
recordings.description: Amount moves from 50% to 0% about three seconds in, while a test voice over 50 Hz mains hum plays through the Dehum. Approaches exact unity at 0%.

recordings.title: Harmonics
recordings.description: Harmonics moves from 4 to 1 about three seconds in, while a test voice over 50 Hz hum and its overtones plays through the Dehum. Limits treatment to fewer hum components.

recordings.title: Threshold
recordings.description: Threshold moves from 50% to 0% about three seconds in, while quiet hiss with sharp clicks plays through the Declick. Detects more subtle clicks.

recordings.title: Reduction
recordings.description: Reduction moves from 70% to 0% about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Denoise. Retains more original sound.

recordings.title: Noise left in
recordings.description: Noise left in moves from 10% to 60% about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Denoise. Retains more background and may sound more natural.

recordings.title: Learn noise
recordings.description: Learn noise is turned on about three seconds in, while quiet background hiss plays through the Denoise. Start learning only while the unwanted background is present.

recordings.title: Strength
recordings.description: Strength moves from 70% to 0% about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Speech Denoise. Retains more of the original signal.

recordings.title: Threshold above noise
recordings.description: Threshold above noise moves from 3 dB to −20 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Spectral Gate. Lets more frequency regions pass.

recordings.title: Reduction
recordings.description: Reduction moves from 40 dB to 10 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Spectral Gate. Keeps more sound in blocked regions.

recordings.title: Learn noise
recordings.description: Learn noise is turned on about three seconds in, while quiet background hiss plays through the Spectral Gate. Start learning only while the unwanted background is present.

properties.nonAudibleReason: Choose WAV or MP3 plays a WAV or MP3 file you choose, so there is no fixed sound to record. The silent Properties tour shows where to find it.

recordings.title: Every setting
recordings.description: A silent tour of the FIR Filter Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

recordings.title: Wet mix
recordings.description: Wet mix moves from 100% to 0% about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the FIR Filter. Includes more dry sound.

recordings.title: Output gain
recordings.description: Output gain moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the FIR Filter. More negative values make it quieter.

recordings.title: Muted
recordings.description: Muted is turned on about three seconds in, while a 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Mute. On sends silence from this tool.

recordings.title: Active input
recordings.description: Active input switches from A to B about three seconds in, while input A carries a low 110 Hz tone and input B a high 880 Hz tone. Which explicitly wired port is heard.

recordings.title: Switch speed
recordings.description: Switch speed switches from Normal to Slow about three seconds in, while input A carries a low 110 Hz tone and input B a high 880 Hz tone. Length of the equal-power input transition.

recordings.title: Active output
recordings.description: Active output switches from A to B about three seconds in, while a low 110 Hz tone plays through the Output Switch. Which output port receives audio. You're listening to output A, so the sound stops when the switch moves to B.

recordings.title: Trigger level
recordings.description: Trigger level moves from −35 dBFS to −80 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Engages for quieter trigger sound, potentially room noise.

recordings.title: Amount
recordings.description: Amount moves from 6 dB to 0 dB about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Keeps it closer to normal level; 0 dB makes no reduction.

recordings.title: Attack
recordings.description: Attack moves from 20 ms to 100 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Makes engagement slower.

recordings.title: Hold
recordings.description: Hold moves from 300 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Bridges longer gaps.

recordings.title: Release
recordings.description: Release moves from 500 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Makes recovery slower.

recordings.title: Rewind buffer
recordings.description: Rewind buffer moves from 60 s to 10 s about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Time Shift. Keeps less history.

recordings.title: Input volume
recordings.description: Input volume moves from 100% to 0% about three seconds in, while a two-tone chord of 110 Hz and 880 Hz plays through the Mixer. Lowers it; 0% removes its contribution.

recordings.title: Preset
recordings.description: Preset switches from Custom to Robot about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The starting voice. Choosing one writes all of its settings at once.

recordings.title: Noise gate
recordings.description: Noise gate moves from −90 dBFS to −20 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Ignores more room and keyboard noise.

recordings.title: Pitch correction
recordings.description: Pitch correction is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The voice keeps its own pitch.

recordings.title: Key
recordings.description: Key switches from C to C♯ about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The key of the correction scale.

recordings.title: Scale
recordings.description: Scale switches from Major to Chromatic about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Which notes correction may use.

recordings.title: Retune speed
recordings.description: Retune speed moves from 50 ms to 150 ms about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Slower, more natural correction.

recordings.title: Humanize
recordings.description: Humanize moves from 0% to 80% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Long notes keep more natural vibrato.

recordings.title: Pitch and formant
recordings.description: Pitch and formant is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The voice keeps its pitch and size.

recordings.title: Pitch
recordings.description: Pitch moves from 7 st to −7 st about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Lower voice; −12 is one octave down.

recordings.title: Fine pitch
recordings.description: Fine pitch moves from 0 cents to 70 cents about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Slightly higher.

recordings.title: Formant
recordings.description: Formant moves from 3 st to −4 st about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Bigger, darker voice.

recordings.title: Ring modulator
recordings.description: Ring modulator is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. No ring modulation.

recordings.title: Ring frequency
recordings.description: Ring frequency moves from 70 Hz to 160 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Bell-like, alien sound.

recordings.title: Ring depth
recordings.description: Ring depth moves from 70% to 20% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More of the normal voice.

recordings.title: Bit crusher
recordings.description: Bit crusher is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Clean sound.

recordings.title: Bits
recordings.description: Bits moves from 6 to 12 about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Cleaner; 16 is clean.

recordings.title: Downsample
recordings.description: Downsample moves from 4 to 12 about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Lo-fi, muffled and aliased.

recordings.title: Saturation
recordings.description: Saturation is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. No distortion.

recordings.title: Drive
recordings.description: Drive moves from 45% to 80% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More distortion.

recordings.title: Whisper
recordings.description: Whisper moves from 0% to 85% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More breathy whisper.

recordings.title: Tone
recordings.description: Tone is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Full range.

recordings.title: Low cut
recordings.description: Low cut moves from 20 Hz to 350 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Thinner sound.

recordings.title: High cut
recordings.description: High cut moves from 20,000 Hz to 3,000 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Duller, more muffled sound.

recordings.title: Peak frequency
recordings.description: Peak frequency moves from 1,000 Hz to 2,500 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Brighter, thinner character.

recordings.title: Peak
recordings.description: Peak moves from 9 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Cuts that frequency.

recordings.title: Modulation
recordings.description: Modulation is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. No modulation.

recordings.title: Modulation type
recordings.description: Modulation type switches from Chorus to Flanger about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Chorus doubles the voice; flanger sweeps it.

recordings.title: Rate
recordings.description: Rate moves from 0.5 Hz to 5 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Faster wobble.

recordings.title: Depth
recordings.description: Depth moves from 60% to 15% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Subtler effect.

recordings.title: Feedback
recordings.description: Feedback moves from 0% to 70% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Ringing, metallic sweeps.

recordings.title: Space
recordings.description: Space is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Dry voice.

recordings.title: Room size
recordings.description: Room size moves from 50% to 85% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Bigger, more distant space.

recordings.title: Echo length
recordings.description: Echo length moves from 1,000 ms to 3,000 ms about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Longer echo.

recordings.title: Echo level
recordings.description: Echo level moves from 40% to 75% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More echo.

recordings.title: Mix
recordings.description: Mix moves from 100% to 30% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More of your normal voice; 0 % is unchanged.

recordings.title: Output
recordings.description: Output moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Quieter.
